summary: Master Fraud Network Mapping and Link Analysis. Learn to detect complex financial crime syndicates using SNA and behavioral forensics.
lede: Fraud network mapping and behavioral analysis help investigators examine connections and behaviors that may indicate complex fraud. Forensic accounting, compliance, internal audit, and corporate investigation professionals can use link analysis, OSINT-based entity resolution, and social network metrics to map relationships, while behavioral red-flag matrices and financial pattern checks support their investigations.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is essential for professionals tasked with identifying, investigating, and mitigating complex fraud risks within corporate, financial, and regulatory environments.
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2 years of experience in audit, compliance, or investigation. Familiarity with basic data analysis tools (such as Excel) is required. Prior exposure to the ACFE® Fraud Examiners Manual or similar forensic frameworks is recommended but not mandatory.
